summary: Espinoza explicitly calls Netanyahu's Gaza war a genocide and urges voters to 'Vote Peace,' positioning himself as non-AIPAC and accusing the organization of controlling both of his opponents. He thanked the Fort Bend County Anti-Genocide/Pro-Palestine team for including him on their recommended slate, citing his Palestine advocacy. His stated language targets Netanyahu specifically, and his organizational backing comes from a local county coalition rather than a named national pro-Palestine body at endorsement level.
